name: The Manhattan of Camarillo
bio: The Manhattan of Camarillo is an Italian restaurant on Santa Rosa Road with live music, an attached beer garden and a private wine room.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from The Manhattan's Facebook, @manhattancamarillo and Visit Camarillo.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
